The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the absence of any statutory or legislative basis, the Jackson/Kenderline approach to the RMa was a judicially imposed economic approach.
the economic approach is inconsistent with the legislative purpose of the RMA and the RMA’s statutory objectives.
, while the Jackson/Kenderding approach has the potential to provide a more robust and consistent basis for decision-making under the RMA, it is not without its problems.
